# SetTextAreaFont

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetTextAreaFont:Void textarea:Int32, font:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textarea` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a text area. |
| `font` | In | Int32 | required | Font handle from `LoadFont` or [RequestFont](RequestFont). |

## Description

Changes the font of the whole text area.

## Differences

* Only the size of the font is used, every font is drawn with the built-in typeface.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Font", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 3)
area = CreateTextArea(10, 10, 270, 90, win)
SetTextAreaFont area, LoadFont("Courier New", 16)
SetGadgetText area, "Courier"
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
